title: MIND THE GAP: HOW ELICITATION PROTOCOLS SHAPE THE STATED-REVEALED PREFERENCE GAP IN LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating large language models (LLMs) on their prioritization of moral and ethical values (e.g., Truthfulness, Justice, Privacy) using the LitmusValues framework and the AIRiskDilemmas dataset, which contains contextualized moral dilemmas.
